entries.rationale: The source defines a finite-universe subset count through membership constraints: A∪X=X forces A into X, while (B−A)∩X={4,8} fixes additional included and excluded elements. A forced/forbidden/free bucket or table would make the classification and free-choice count transparent, but the source is fully specified and the same reasoning can be reproduced clearly in text, so the visual is helpful rather than hard-required.

The source asks for the maximum and minimum of the 제주도-only region in a two-activity population, with a fixed total, a difference between the two selected counts, and a condition relating neither-selected students to the union. The decisive reasoning is the four-region decomposition (제주도 only, 서울 only, both, neither) together with the two extreme configurations, so a cardinality Venn visual is the canonical required representation.

The source is a symbolic symmetric-difference condition on two parameterized finite sets. Its visualizable structure is an exhaustive case partition tracking element collisions, validity, and elimination reasons; that table could support the parameter analysis, but the source does not require a geometric or region visual and the symbolic case work remains self-contained in text, so the visual is optional.
